title: How to Drain a Gas Water Heater
description:
Ever wondered how to save on energy bills and be eco-friendly at the same time? Join Dylan as he walks us through draining a gas water heater! 🛠️🌱

Did you know that your water heater should be drained annually in order to avoid sediment building up at the bottom? When that happens, your unit keeps heating, but the tank fills with less and less water. You’ll start noticing your hot water goes out faster while your energy bill increases year over year. Not to mention, you can end up burning out your water heater early, leading to a costly replacement.
